Want to watch the basketball games at Carver Gymnasium for free this winter?
Just bring your student ID to the ticket booth at Section J, and you'll get in without paying a dime.
You can also buy up to two guest tickets for $20 each.
Remember, it's first come, first served, especially for weekend games, so come early!
If you're planning to bring friends to any games in February, heads up: Guest tickets are super limited, so grab them as soon as you can.
